observations: The original shared heat/cold stack reads already try fixed slots type-100 and only fall back to dictionary get when the key/position differs.
Therefore86%state reuse does not imply eliminating86%general dictionary lookups. The common baseline operation is already a few direct field reads.
The segment wrapper adds per-item row/dispatch/audit/metadata guards and snapshot pointer tests. Their cost can offset the saved reads.

The original item tick has only Gem.character, getSpeed fallback, cooldown display hook and trigger as external-call boundaries; the prototype clears at each and before character/gem phases. No charge-path callback is hidden in this function.
next_frame_experiment_requirement: Measure the complete original item tick versus segment helper on a persistent representative fixture before paying for another full frame-only build. If revising, reduce duplicate guards/reads while preserving unknown receivers and every callback barrier.
